summary: NVIDIA Developer Program members can access NVIDIA-hosted NIM API endpoints for free development and prototyping. Free access is rate-limited according to the model, use case and current traffic; no fixed numeric allowance is promised here. Hosted prototyping is distinct from paid production deployment or self-hosted infrastructure.
claim_steps: Visit https://build.nvidia.com and choose a model exposing an NVIDIA-hosted free endpoint.
On its model page, click Get API Key and sign in or create an NVIDIA account to join the Developer Program.
Use the displayed API example with your key, within the endpoint's current free rate limits. Hosted prototyping is distinct from paid production/self-host infrastructure.

social_proof.text: Get free access to NIM API endpoints for unlimited prototyping, powered by DGX Cloud.
